recentItems.title: New Opportunities in CIFTIS | Global Flavors within a 15-Minute Living Circle
recentItems.description: Local markets, global flavors! Thanks to efficient logistics and expanding market access with 264 new agrifood items from 79 countries approved this year, Beijing's markets are more international than ever. Get a glimpse into the lively buzz of the markets and feel the dynamic pull of China's trade in services connecting the world!

recentItems.title: Why do Chinese take a more optimistic view of AI?
recentItems.description:
🤖 A recent survey suggests 69% of Chinese people see AI's benefits outweigh its risks.
So why the optimism?
Practical benefits in everyday life, stronger legal safeguards, and a society accustomed to rapid change could all be part of the answer. 🔍

recentItems.title: Industry insiders highlight China's role in advancing low-carbon transition
recentItems.description:
"You are doing so great in terms of solar, photovoltaic and wind energy. So we have to work together closely between Germany and China."
Industry insiders attending the Taiyuan Energy Low-Carbon Development Forum highlight China's role in advancing low-carbon transition. #LowCarbon

recentItems.title: Exploring China's culture-tourism expo in Tianjin
recentItems.description: The 2026 China Culture & Tourism Industries Expo, held in north China's Tianjin, has attracted over 2,500 enterprises from 20 countries and regions. Join Xinhua's Zhang Yuqi to meet international exhibitors, explore their offerings and gain insights into opportunities in Chinese tourism market. (recorded) #ChinaTravel #CTIE

recentItems.title: Exploring thriving nighttime economy at revitalized waterfront in Chongqing, China
recentItems.description: Glittering skyline, stunning river views, international cuisines, drone light shows and live music... Join Xinhua's Yu Xiaosu on a tour of the revitalized waterfront along Nanbin Road in Chongqing, southwest China, and explore the diverse experiences offered by the city's thriving nighttime economy. (recorded) #ChinaTravel

recentItems.title: Vlog | How media cooperation can foster shared prosperity of Asia-Pacific
recentItems.description: The Organizing Committee of the Asia-Pacific Media Partnership Program was jointly formed by 16 founding organizations from China and abroad at the opening ceremony of the Asia-Pacific Media Forum on Saturday in Shenzhen, south China's Guangdong Province. Forum attendees shared their views on how media can work together to foster regional dialogue and cooperation. #AsiaPacific #MediaCooperation #APEC #China #Shenzhen

recentItems.title: Asia-Pacific media voice support for stronger regional cooperation, shared development
recentItems.description: More than 400 representatives across the Asia-Pacific region and beyond have gathered in Shenzhen, China's innovation hub, for the Asia-Pacific Media Forum. Participants voiced support for stronger regional cooperation and shared development.
